paragraphs: Geviha of Bei Ketil: Avodah Zarah 22a; before Rav Ashi, Yevamot 60, beginning of side a; Menachot 8a; Chullin 26b. He expounded at the entrance of the exilarch: Beitzah 23a. Rav Geviha of Bei Ketil said to Rav Ashi: Bava Batra 83a. See part 1, year 4187.
